text:
luis-finance: Quick flag - vendor SolarBrasil (VB-339) sent INV-BR-551 dated 2026-04-14 and included a 1.5% "retencao" withholding plus a 2% gross-up. PO 7333 is for Redwood Ltd (GB). Can tax confirm treatment?
ana-ops: Invoice addressed to Redwood, Inc (US) but PO target is Redwood Ltd. Snippet: `Net BRL 100,000, Retencao 1.5% = BRL 1,500, Gross-up +BRL 2,000, VAT/ISS N/A`
bruno-legal: Two immediate actions: hold payment and ask vendor to reissue to Redwood Ltd (GB VAT on PO). Gross-up needs a contractual amendment. Brazil withholding (retencao) can apply to certain services but vendor should provide DARF or comprovante if withheld.
tax-bot: Auto-check: vendor country=BR, no W-8/W-9 on file. Guidance: 1) Request reissued invoice to GB entity; 2) deny gross-up unless signed change to SOW; 3) if vendor withholds at source, require official tax voucher (DARF) showing amounts withheld so we can reconcile; 4) for US entity invoicing, W-8/W-9 only relevant for US tax reporting when Redwood, Inc pays them.
luis-finance: Placed ON_HOLD in AP and emailed vendor asking for reissue + DARF + contract reference for gross-up. Draft message: `Hi SolarBrasil, PO 7333 is to Redwood Ltd (VAT GB987654321). Please reissue invoice to Redwood Ltd and remove any gross-up unless you provide a signed amendment. If any Brazilian withholding applies, send the official DARF/receipt. Payment will remain on hold until we receive corrected docs.`
ap-bot: Invoice INV-BR-551 -> ON_HOLD at 2026-04-15T09:04:00Z.
vendor-brasil: Reply 2026-04-15 10:20 BRT: "Will reissue to Redwood Ltd and upload DARF if retention occurs. Gross-up was internal ask; we'll retract unless you accept amendment"
luis-finance: Thanks - will clear once reissued invoice + any vouchers are uploaded. Keep audit copy of original and reissue for tax.
